answerBy.title: Please answer by {date}
answerBy.body: {buyer} at {company} asks you to confirm the quantities and dates, or to say what you can do instead.
answerBy.bodyNoBuyer: {company} asks you to confirm the quantities and dates, or to say what you can do instead.

order.title: The order
order.pdf: The PDF of this order is in the e-mail we sent you.
order.noPrices: This page shows what and when, never prices.

lines.crVi: Cr VI test report needed with each lot

answer.title: Your answer

outcome.CONFIRMED: Confirming tells {buyer} the order is on as asked.
outcome.PROPOSED: {buyer} accepts or refuses your changes. Nothing is confirmed until then.
outcome.DECLINED: You cannot deliver any line: sending this declines the order.

answer.refHint: Optional. We print it on our documents.
answer.name: Your name

held.incomplete: A line's answer is not complete: open it and save it again.
held.uploading: Wait until your PDF is uploaded.
held.file: Choose your PDF again, or remove it.
held.name: Type your name first.
held.ref: Your number is at most 60 characters.
held.note: The note is at most 1000 characters.

file.title: Your confirmation PDF
file.hint: Optional: your own confirmation as a PDF, at most 20 MB. It goes with your answer.
file.quarantined: {name} did not arrive as it was sent. Choose it again.
file.failed: {name} could not be uploaded. Choose it again.

rejected.notPdf: {name} is not a PDF. Choose a PDF file.

OTHER.title: Another date or quantity
OTHER.body: One delivery, at another date, of another quantity, or both.

SPLIT.title: In two deliveries
SPLIT.body: Part now, the rest later: each with its quantity and date.

CANNOT_DELIVER.title: I cannot deliver this line
CANNOT_DELIVER.body: Nothing of this line. The other lines keep your answer.

whole.nothing: Give another quantity, another date, or both.
whole.same: That is what was asked: choose “As asked”.
whole.sameDay: The two deliveries are on two different days.

quantity.number: Give the quantity as a number, with at most four decimals.
quantity.positive: Give a quantity above 0, or choose “I cannot deliver this line”.

date.past: Give a date from today on.
date.far: Give a date within two years.

reason.missing: Say why, in a few words.

decline.title: Decline this order
decline.body: {buyer} sees your answer at once. If you can deliver part of the order, answer line by line instead.

CONFIRMED.title: Confirmed — thank you
CONFIRMED.expect: We expect the goods at {site} by {date}.
CONFIRMED.expectRange: We expect the goods at {site} from {first} to {last}.
CONFIRMED.later: Need to change something later? Reply to our e-mail; it reaches {buyer}.

PROPOSED.title: Sent — {buyer} decides on your changes
PROPOSED.body: Your answer: {summary}. Nothing is confirmed until {buyer} accepts or refuses your changes; you will hear back by e-mail.

DECLINED.title: Declined
DECLINED.body: {buyer} sees it now and will get back to you.

CONFIRMED.title: This order is confirmed
CONFIRMED.body: There is nothing more to answer. Need to change something? Reply to our e-mail.

CHANGES_PROPOSED.title: Your changes are with {buyer}
CHANGES_PROPOSED.body: {buyer} accepts or refuses them. You will hear back by e-mail.

DECLINED.title: You declined this order
DECLINED.body: {buyer} changes it or cancels it, and gets back to you.

PARTLY_RECEIVED.title: Goods of this order are arriving
PARTLY_RECEIVED.body: Part of it was received already: it needs no confirmation any more.

RECEIVED.title: This order was received
RECEIVED.body: The goods arrived: it needs no confirmation any more.

DRAFT.title: The buyer is changing this order
DRAFT.body: The changed order comes to you with a new link.

CANCELLED.title: This order was cancelled
CANCELLED.body: It needs no answer. Reply to our e-mail with any question.

CLOSED.title: This order is closed
CLOSED.body: It needs no answer any more.

other.title: This order needs no answer now
other.body: Reply to our e-mail with any question.

problem.changed: This order changed a moment ago. Look at it again: what you typed is kept.
problem.notAnswerable: This order takes no answer any more.
problem.invalid: Some answers are not complete. Open each changed line and check it.
problem.rateLimited: Too many tries. Wait a minute, then send again.
problem.unavailableNow: We cannot reach our system right now. Your answer was not sent: try again in a moment.
problem.internal: Something went wrong on our side. Your answer was not sent: try again.
problem.upload: Your PDF could not be uploaded. Choose it again, or send your answer without it.

dead.asked: Asked — we passed it on. If the link was ours, {sender} writes to the address it was sent to.
dead.askedAnonymous: Asked — we passed it on. If the link was ours, the sender writes to the address it was sent to.
dead.expiredBodyAnonymous: Ask whoever sent it to you for a new one.

error.title: The order could not be opened
error.body: Something went wrong on our side. Try again.
